cmu.name: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database (cgspeed BVH conversion, 2010 release)
cmu.licence: No restrictions stated by CMU (FAQ: may be copied, modified or redistributed); conversion adds none. Not a formal licence.
cmu.credit:
The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu.
The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217.
cmu.note: Files are the unchanged BVH conversion (CMU skeleton, not the Second Life skeleton). Convert with tools/cmu_to_sl.py.
